loop: Picker chooses a nearby seated Duck; selection automatically happens after 15 seconds if needed.
Picker becomes Runner; selected Duck becomes Goose and receives their bat.
Runner must complete the marked clockwise outside lap before claiming the gold seat.
A successful seat claim seats Runner and promotes Goose to Picker.
A valid Goose bat hit eliminates Runner and promotes Goose to Picker.
At 180 seconds Picker or Runner loses, eliminated players lose, and all other surviving Ducks win.
A sole legitimate survivor waits as FinalDuck until the timer expires and wins. Too few players caused by departures cancels rewards.

controls.choose: E / gamepad Y near a seated Duck, or GOOSE touch button
controls.sprint: Shift / gamepad L3 / right-side mobile SPRINT hold
controls.swing: Existing equipment click/tap/gamepad swing controls; active Goose only

checks.method: Edit-mode isolated fixtures with native Roblox objects and mocked players/time/input. No live players, persistent economy data or published game modified.

remainingValidation: A two-or-more-player Play session to assess live replication, input feel and chase balance.
